title: fix(types): integrate declarations and preserve strict Table contracts
head: integration/public-declaration-table-test-modes-20261009
body:
This successor integrates the original Table author's two-file test fix c95d49a2 after exact preimage matching. The nullability contract now compares Table against core Popper in the repository's existing compiler mode, while independent strict source/emitted checks explicitly preserve non-null acceptance and original negative controls. It changes only the Table test-d and its paired-control runner; production, config, source manifest, authority, lock and producer scripts are unchanged.

Actual source a5e839e4160ec64dafabb162c6168851de54b1b1: complete Vitest no-cache typecheck passes (2d05f previously had one TS2344), two focused Table runtime cases pass, strict source/declaration/emitted negatives retain original 2/1/2 then fixed zero, original non-strict-null mode retains one negative then fixed zero. Strict actual nullability accepts-null=false for both fixed types; non-strict mode is not claimed as non-null evidence. Runtime JS parity and exact two-file lint pass. Fresh main 8db0 merge-tree has no conflicts.

No unchanged package/broad suites were repeated for this test-only successor. Production tarball qualification remains at frozen source 2d05f, SHA256 6da2fe1a5573a04768a4f8280899b45dabaa4f93ca72a278d48c50faca17649a; its full strict package check still fails 10 and original producer still has twelve independent TS7056. Earlier authority/dependency source closure and five author source offers are retained. Newly assigned component scopes remain with root-selected writers. Runtime/browser/device notch and published-artifact acceptance remains OPEN; no remote CI or all-package PASS is claimed. No publication, default push, merge, CSP/security change or alias repointing.
